violations.description: General employee practices. — --Open can of soda sitting inside prep cooler.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not properly date marked. -No items in walk in cooler or prep cooler had date marks.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean inside all coolers and shelving in walk in cooler.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean all shelving in kitchen. -Clean handles on prep coolers.
Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. -Clean dishwasher inside and out.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Kitchen and walk in cooler need a thorough cleaning.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean inside coolers on cook line and in upright freezer.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Box of pork loins on floor by dishwasher.
